title: HF1283 (2025-2026 Regular): Discharge papers of a veteran made to be considered the legal equivalent of a permit to carry a firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-20; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/1283/versions/0/)

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 25): Notwithstanding any provision in this section or other law to the contrary, a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, may carry a pistol as provided in this subdivision under any circumstances and in any location in which a permit to carry is otherwise required.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 25): The veteran must possess the original or a certified copy of the veteran's government form DD214 while carrying the pistol.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 25): The veteran is not required to apply for a permit to carry, pay any fees, or demonstrate training in the safe use of a pistol.
